secondary.dfm_attribution: Native policy has a higher observed score against the shared raw opponent than DFM1 or DFM8. A direct native-versus-DFM matchup was not part of this matrix.

historical_raw_anchor_comparison.interpretation: Observed score improvement on a reused benchmark; no separate causal or held-out significance claim.

weight_movement.normalization: L2 distance from the verified matching initialization divided by its L2 norm; pretrained and freshly initialized modules are reported separately.
weight_movement.interpretation: Greater backbone movement is concentrated in the embedding stack, not broad additional transformer adaptation. This is not evidence of better representations by itself.

limitations: Searchless native-PyTorch arena only, with training-matched inputs: full history for HH-002 and raw BT4, current-only for historical Hero1.
Already-exposed development openings, uncertified training source-game overlap, no held-out promotion or absolute Elo/SOTA claim.
Confidence intervals are marginal bounded-pair Hoeffding intervals, not simultaneous across the seven comparisons.
Single seed, 553 versus 554 training updates and a slightly contracted training set; not a pure causal history-training comparison.
Backbone movement is measured in stored BF16 weights, not optimizer-master weights; zero-initialized added tensors have undefined relative movement.

budget.meter_note: Month-to-date compute before credits, excluding explicitly waived storage. Meter can lag; the difference is not a final per-experiment invoice.

next_action: Do not automatically promote this DFM checkpoint to matched search; retain the full-history raw-BT4 anchor and investigate training/refinement under a separately frozen protocol.
